description: This file contains a serializer (codec) for the IPAddress type used in Orleans.Serialization framework. It implements reading and writing IPAddress instances to a wire protocol, including raw byte handling and reference tracking.

classes.name: IPAddressCodec
classes.description: Serializer for IPAddress that handles reading and writing IPAddress objects to a wire format, with support for reference tracking and wire protocol specifics.

classes.name: IPAddressCopier
classes.description: A shallow copier class for IPAddress, used for lightweight object cloning within Orleans serialization.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads an IPAddress value from the reader, handling references if necessary.

methods.name: ReadRaw
methods.description: Reads the raw length-prefixed IPAddress bytes from the reader and returns an IPAddress object.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes an IPAddress field to the writer with optional reference tracking.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes the raw length-prefixed IPAddress bytes to the writer.
